resurrection_plan.title: Replace Broken Cryptographic Digest: hashlib.md5
resurrection_plan.description: The legacy session digest uses MD5 which is vulnerable to collision attacks. It must be upgraded to SHA-256 or HMAC before running in production.
resurrection_plan.expected_benefit: Guarantees cryptographic integrity of edge station session tokens; blocks collision forgery.
suggested_steps: Import hashlib and hmac in auth_legacy.py
Update compute_legacy_session_digest to use HMAC-SHA256
Ensure client stations submit updated digest format or provision backward-compatible grace period

+    import hmac

hypothesis_timeline.observed_fact: Commit 38eadad initialized repository with README.md declaring 'ChronoLog / AetherStream Edge Telemetry Core' and backend/utils.py math helpers.
hypothesis_timeline.inferred_hypothesis: The project was originally architected as an edge daemon running on Alpine Linux ARM64 hardware to capture micro-meteorological sensor metrics (temperature, pressure, humidity) at weather stations.
hypothesis_timeline.uncertainty_notes: Exact remote station hardware models and physical sensor buses (I2C/SPI) are not explicitly documented.

hypothesis_timeline.observed_fact: TelemetryWindowBuffer implemented in backend/pipeline.py computes running mean, variance, and flags points exceeding 2.5 standard deviations.
hypothesis_timeline.inferred_hypothesis: The edge service evaluated meteorological signal stability locally, buffering only anomalous spikes for priority transmission to avoid saturating low-bandwidth satellite / edge links.
hypothesis_timeline.uncertainty_notes: Fixed threshold_sigma=2.5 lacks auto-calibration logic or automated test verification.

hypothesis_timeline.epoch: Network Handshake & Technical Debt Ingestion (Sept 2021 - Jan 2022)
hypothesis_timeline.observed_fact: FastAPI routing added in backend/server.py with station token verification. Insecure MD5 session hashing implemented in backend/auth_legacy.py with an unresolved FIXME comment. Canvas live visualizer added in frontend/app.js.
hypothesis_timeline.inferred_hypothesis: As contributors Alex Chen and Dave Miller joined, network connectivity and operator monitoring screens were rapidly integrated. The MD5 hashing and unverified cold vault key function were temporary prototype placeholders that were never properly modernized.
hypothesis_timeline.uncertainty_notes: Whether the cold vault recovery function was ever invoked out-of-band by operator CLI scripts is uncertain.

hypothesis_timeline.observed_fact: Commit 6486e1a added fast batch processing while orphaning legacy_raw_socket_streamer. Final commit c5ed1f0 left DEPRECATION_NOTICE.txt confirming project decommissioning and team reassignment.
hypothesis_timeline.inferred_hypothesis: An architectural migration to high-throughput batch buffers was in progress when corporate/team priorities shifted, resulting in the code being abandoned in an unmaintained, partially-migrated state.
hypothesis_timeline.uncertainty_notes: Zero residual uncertainty on abandonment; confirmed by official deprecation notice file and 4+ years of Git dormancy.
